{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in body_mass_g
print(f"Missing values in body_mass_g: {data['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()}")

# Compute the mean body mass, ignoring missing values
mean_body_mass = data['body_mass_g'].mean()

print(f"Mean body mass: {mean_body_mass}")"}
